cs.t: Off-topic, but that's a truly terrible bike. I know a few people who've gotten it or similar GMC's as "the first result on Amazon for road bike" and they've all had problems with chains breaking or very poor fit of components. I'd recommend  http://www.bikesdirect.com/  for cheap bikes online if you're comfortable with assembly and tuning.
cs.th: Amazon raised Prime Day prices, misleading consumers, says vendor
